controlling_decision: DATA-01: Accepted Public Data Source Decisions
purpose: Accepted public validation-source contract consumable by PIPE without source, vintage, or release inference.
content_hash_semantics: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON after removing content_sha256: recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, Unicode preserved, no NaN.
supersession_policy: Do not overwrite an accepted artifact. A correction creates a versioned successor with this artifact_id in supersedes and a newly calculated content_sha256.
failure_behavior: Fail closed if this artifact ID/version/hash is absent or differs, if a source is latest/current/moving, or if the source family, product, vintage, or required B11001 estimate/MOE identity differs. No source or vintage substitution is permitted.
